name: cancel_order
description: Cancel an open order by id. Confirm-gated: first call (no `confirm`) returns a preview; a second call with `confirm: true` sends the cancel, which additionally requires the MCP server to be started with `:allow-orders? true`.

order_id.description: The order id returned by place_order.

confirm.description: Must be true on the second call to actually send the cancel. Default false (preview).
